sample_sams.description: Per-sample alignment map (form B): sample_id -> SAM/BAM path of the Ma/Aq/MM-tagged alignment (BAM needs an index for region fetch). Values must be built from an upstream config outdir (f-string), so DAG dependency tracking follows the producing rule; keys must be plain sample_ids.

enabled.description: Opt-in figure delivery gate (node.py registration; default false - the module is wired but produces nothing until enabled).

loci.description: Loci file (user-facing), one locus per row: BED rows (chrom<TAB>start<TAB>end[<TAB>name]) or [NAME=]chrom:start-end lines. Required when enabled. node.py parses it into loci_map.

loci_map.description: Generated by node.py: panel name (shell-safe, deduped) -> 'chrom:start-end'. Consumed by the module for output naming and per-locus engine calls; do not hand-fill.

sample_group_dict.description: sample_id -> group label shown in figure labels ('s1 (aged)'); hand-filled values win, node.py auto-fills from the meta group column.

variants.description: Figure variants per locus: 'plain' (<name>.<fmt>) and/or 'zoom' (<name>_zoom.<fmt>, the paper-style selection + 150 bp zoom row).

max_fibers.description: Fiber rows drawn per sample (most aligned bases in the locus first).

zoom_bp.description: Width of the zoomed region in bp (the light-blue box; the grey key shadow is 1/3 of it; the 150 bp scale bar sits at the fiber level).

formats.description: Image formats written simultaneously (matplotlib savefig set: png pdf svg ps eps tif tiff jpg jpeg pgf raw rgba).

dpi.description: Resolution for raster formats; vector formats ignore it.
